aboutGame.title: What is Killer or Innocent?
paragraphs: Killer or Innocent is a Roblox social deduction game built around a hidden-role murder mystery. Every round secretly splits the lobby into killers and innocents, then drops both sides onto the same map with completely different goals: one side hunts in secret, while the other survives, investigates, and votes out the threat.

Because rounds are decided by reading other players rather than raw combat, Killer or Innocent rewards observation, communication, and fast decisions. Our wiki collects role breakdowns, clue and evidence mechanics, control layouts, code lists, and progression guides so you can play either side with confidence.

faq.title: Killer or Innocent FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Killer or Innocent.

items.question: What is Killer or Innocent?
items.answer: Killer or Innocent is a Roblox social deduction game where every round secretly splits the lobby into killers and innocents. Killers try to eliminate the other players without being caught, while innocents survive, gather clues, and vote out the killer.

items.question: How do you play Killer or Innocent on Roblox?
items.answer: Join a Killer or Innocent lobby from the Roblox game page and collect your secret role. Killers then hunt in secret, innocents finish objectives and watch for suspicious behaviour, and everyone votes once the round reaches its discussion phase.

items.question: Which Killer or Innocent role should beginners pick?
items.answer: Start with the innocent role in Killer or Innocent. It teaches map awareness and clue reading without the pressure of hunting, and the detective role is the natural next step once you can spot suspicious movement.

items.question: How do I get codes for Killer or Innocent?
items.answer: Check the Killer or Innocent codes page for the current list, then enter each code exactly as written in the in-game redeem menu to collect the reward before it expires.

items.question: How many roles are in Killer or Innocent?
items.answer: Killer or Innocent rounds assign hidden roles such as killer, innocent, detective, murderer, and bystander. Every role has its own goal, so the same lobby plays out very differently depending on what you are given.
